summary: Pruned 23 finished rows (the 4-6 Jul weekend crop incl. Hollyfest, Berrylands Summer Festival, Canbury KMS bands, plus ended runs REPLAY, FUSE, Irvine's Funfair, Take Flight). Added 79 dated events from four research sweeps. Standout wins: (1) the National Trust bot-block LIFTED, confirming the full Claremont Live season (Othello 12 Jul, Midsummer Night's Dream 9 Jul, Three Musketeers 23 Jul, Peter Rabbit 25 Jul, four Saturday-afternoon music sessions in Aug, Magic Faraway Tree trail 18 Jul-31 Aug) plus Ham House Summer Games (21 Jul-2 Sep); (2) the All Saints Kingston autumn Monday lunchtime recital series - a gap tracked for four runs - is finally published: all 12 free recitals (14 Sep-30 Nov) added with named performers; (3) NEW SOURCE excellar.co.uk (www!) exposes ExCellar's own dated calendar: monthly Ex Cellar Jazz Fridays (18 Sep Funkestra, 16 Oct, 20 Nov, 11 Dec) and Red Hot Rhythm Revival 1920s-30s hot jazz (31 Oct); (4) Ram Jam's Speakeasy Brunch daytime-music series is now dated through December (9 Saturdays) plus two Sofar Sounds nights. Also new: Rose comedy (Jack Dee's Comedy Crackers 4 Dec, Live at Christmas 7 Dec, Murder She Didn't Write 2 Nov, free Board Game Day 19 Sep), Kingston Regatta (11-12 Jul), Harmony Riot pop-punk choir at All Saints (17 Jul), Banquet in-stores (White Skies 8 Jul, Holy Coves 17 Aug) and Jack White listening party, Vera Fletcher Hall film + Victoria Wood shows (2/16 Oct, via Datathistle - venue site is captcha-walled), Stanley Picker Gallery exhibitions, The Lamb's monthly life-drawing series (6 dates), summer-holiday library specials (Lego, crafts, Explore Learning workshops, Yu-gi-oh), and cornerHOUSE children's drama weeks. 21 rows confirmed/verify-cleared, mostly prices/times off Surbiton Partnership event pages; Willoughby Arms Monday trad session confirmed still running. The Lamb wall is now PROVEN social-only: its Wix Events API returns an empty array, so no fetchable dated source exists. Rose's Jan-May 2027 season (Ronnie Scott's Story, Frankenstein) watchlisted pending 2027 range extension.
